content: GitHub now offers native ARM64-hosted runners via runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm (no QEMU). Standard pattern: a build matrix with {platform: linux/arm64, runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm} builds/pushes straight to ghcr.io via docker/build-push-action, login via docker/login-action using GITHUB_TOKEN. Native build is dramatically faster than QEMU cross-build (observed ~2m45s vs ~10m20s in one case study). ARM Linux runner minutes bill at the same 1x multiplier as amd64 Linux on GitHub Actions (as of Jan 2026 pricing), so budget impact is negligible for a solo low-frequency-deploy project.
